procedures.name: Process Injection
procedures.description: Adversaries may inject code into processes to evade process-based defenses and/or elevate privileges.

procedures.name: Remote Service Session Initiation
procedures.description: Adversaries may use valid accounts to interact with remote systems using Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP).

procedures.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
procedures.description: Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands, scripts, or binaries.

procedures.name: Credential Dumping
procedures.description: Adversaries may attempt to extract credential material from the operating system and software.

procedures.name: Registry Run Keys
procedures.mitre_name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution - Registry Run Keys
procedures.description: Adversaries may achieve persistence by adding a program to a startup folder or referencing it with a registry run key.

queries.name: CreateRemoteThread API Calls
queries.description: Detects usage of CreateRemoteThread API which is commonly used for process injection attacks.
queries.query_syntax: SELECT * FROM win:ProcessCreate WHERE TargetObject LIKE '%CreateRemoteThread%' OR CallStack LIKE '%CreateRemoteThread%'

queries.name: Sysmon Process Injection Detection
queries.description: Uses Sysmon Event ID 8 to detect CreateRemoteThread operations indicating potential process injection.
queries.query_syntax: SELECT * FROM sysmon WHERE EventID = 8 AND TargetObject LIKE '%CreateRemoteThread%'

queries.name: VirtualAllocEx and WriteProcessMemory Sequence
queries.description: Detects the suspicious sequence of VirtualAllocEx followed by WriteProcessMemory API calls.
queries.query_syntax: SELECT * FROM api_calls WHERE (FunctionName = 'VirtualAllocEx' OR FunctionName = 'WriteProcessMemory') AND ProcessName NOT IN ('System', 'explorer.exe')

queries.name: RDP Connection Attempts
queries.description: Detects RDP connection attempts by monitoring network connections on port 3389.
queries.query_syntax: SELECT * FROM network_connections WHERE DestinationPort = 3389 AND Protocol = 'TCP'

queries.name: Lateral Movement via WMI
queries.description: Detects lateral movement attempts using WMI for remote command execution.
queries.query_syntax: SELECT * FROM process_create WHERE CommandLine LIKE '%wmic%' AND CommandLine LIKE '%remote%'

queries.name: PowerShell Script Execution
queries.description: Detects PowerShell script execution with suspicious parameters or encoded commands.
queries.query_syntax: SELECT * FROM process_create WHERE ParentImage LIKE '%powershell%' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-enc%' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-EncodedCommand%')

queries.name: CMD.exe Spawned by Office Applications
queries.description: Detects cmd.exe spawned by Microsoft Office applications which is indicative of exploitation.
queries.query_syntax: SELECT * FROM process_create WHERE ParentImage LIKE '%winword%' OR ParentImage LIKE '%excel%' OR ParentImage LIKE '%powerpnt%' AND Image LIKE '%cmd.exe%'

queries.name: Suspicious Script Interpreter Execution
queries.description: Detects execution of script interpreters (cscript.exe, wscript.exe) with suspicious parameters.
queries.query_syntax: SELECT * FROM process_create WHERE (Image LIKE '%cscript.exe%' OR Image LIKE '%wscript.exe%') AND CommandLine LIKE '%.js%' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs%'

queries.name: LSASS Memory Dump Attempts
queries.description: Detects attempts to dump LSASS process memory using tools like procdump or rundll32.
queries.query_syntax: SELECT * FROM process_create WHERE (CommandLine LIKE '%lsass%' AND CommandLine LIKE '%dump%') OR (Image LIKE '%procdump%' AND CommandLine LIKE '%lsass%')

queries.name: Mimikatz Execution Detection
queries.description: Detects execution of Mimikatz tool or similar credential dumping utilities.
queries.query_syntax: SELECT * FROM process_create WHERE (Image LIKE '%mimikatz%' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mimikatz%') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%sekurlsa%' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lsadump%')

queries.name: Registry Run Key Modifications
queries.description: Detects modifications to Windows Registry Run keys commonly used for persistence.
queries.query_syntax: SELECT * FROM registry_events WHERE TargetObject LIKE '%Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run%' AND EventType = 'CreateKey' OR EventType = 'SetValue'

queries.name: Startup Folder Modifications
queries.description: Detects file creation or modification in Windows Startup folders.
queries.query_syntax: SELECT * FROM file_events WHERE TargetFilename LIKE '%\\Startup\\%' AND (EventType = 'CreateKey' OR EventType = 'SetValue')
